slot_scores.name: ending_backorders_zero
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether all backorders must be cleared by the end of June or whether demand must be fully satisfied by the planning horizon. The READY_TO_MODEL summary also omits any terminal backorder condition.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Backorders may remain positive at the end of June; no terminal condition requiring ending backorders to be zero was included.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about or confirmed a terminal backorder constraint, and the READY_TO_MODEL summary lists only I_6 >= 10,000 with no B_6 = 0 or all-demand-satisfied condition.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 hidden slot H1 about clearing ending backorders remained unresolved and was silently omitted from the model.

summary: The agent asked many detailed and useful clarification questions about costs, workforce timing, overtime, and inventory/backorder mechanics, but it missed the terminal backorder-clearing condition and stopped with that P1 issue unresolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
